title: A Love Questioned
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: God's first words on the last page of the Old Testament are four words: I have loved you. And His own people answer, How? About a hundred years after the exile, they had rebuilt the temple and lost the fire, and when you quit believing God loves you, your worship turns into leftovers. But we brought the blind and the lame, and God brought a Lamb. He's a great King, and He has already set a seat at His table for you.
subtitle: Malachi Week 1
